text.en:
The Manila Railroad Company is hereby exempted from all taxes and assessments, of every
name and nature, either municipal, provincial, or insular, until December thirty-first, nineteen hundred and
Until December thirty-first, nineteen hundred and twenty-two, no specific tax shall be collected on any article
sold or delivered directly to the Manila Railroad Company.

This Act shall take effect as of January first, nineteen hundred and twenty-one.
Approved, February 20, 1921.
